key_insight: XStack benchmarks AI agents on migrating entire ML repositories from PyTorch on NVIDIA GPUs to JAX on Google TPUs, revealing that reliable migration remains difficult.
engineering_relevance: Successful migration could let researchers choose hardware without being locked into a repository’s original framework and accelerator ecosystem.
method: Provide each agent with a PyTorch repository and a clean TPU machine.
Require a working JAX repository spanning framework and hardware migration.
Grade outputs against criteria based on published source-repository results, authenticated and calibrated by the benchmark authors.
evidence_signal: Reported pass rates are 75% for Claude Opus 5, 45% for GPT-5.6-sol, and at most 40% for every other evaluated agent.
watch_item: The abstract does not specify benchmark size or repository diversity, limiting assessment of how broadly the reported pass rates generalize.
paper_title: XStack: A Benchmark for ML Repo Migration
